designationHistory.indexText: Established on September 1, 1943, when land on the Rio Grande was acquired with Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval as a refuge for migratory birds.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Santa Ana National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

Santa Ana NWR Annual Narrative Report 1985 (National Archives, RG 22): "Establishing Legislation: Date: 01 September 1943. Action: Acquired, under approval of the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission"

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date from the refuge's own narrative report.
